features.title: Compact, secure lockers
features.text: Built for today’s flexible offices, core Lockers provide safe, secure storage, keeping personal items protected and accessible, perfect for hot-desking teams and hybrid work environments.

features.title: Long-lasting metal lockers
features.text: Compact lockers designed to keep personal items secure and accessible in shared office environments.

features.title: Secure cam lock system
features.text: Crafted from powder-coated metal, Core Lockers offer durability and low maintenance for daily office use.

features.title: Flexible locker configurations
features.text: Each locker features a secure cam lock, giving users individual peace of mind in shared workspaces.

features.title: Lockers for agile workplaces
features.text: Core Lockers come in 4- and 8-door variants, scaling easily with workplace demands.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
